load_CLIP_model: load a CLIP model by name such as ViT-B/32 to a specified device like cuda or cpu
tokenize_text_for_CLIP: tokenize text strings into a tensor with start and end tokens for CLIP model input
download_CLIP_model_checkpoint: download a CLIP model checkpoint from OpenAI with SHA256 checksum verification and caching
get_available_CLIP_models: get a list of available CLIP model names like RN50 ViT-B/32 and ViT-L/14
transform_image_for_CLIP: apply image preprocessing with resize center crop and normalization for CLIP model input
